assessment.nobel_worthiness: Highly distinctive voice: dreamlike, anti-realist narrative worlds that unsettle ordinary psychology, space and causality, sustained across novels and many stories (e.g. Frontier, Love in the New Millennium). Formal radicalism and imaginative depth are consistent across decades, and the work does not rely on a conventional realist or national-allegory frame. Her literary lineage is often discussed in relation to Kafka, Borges and Chinese modernism, which supports a claim of idiosyncratic achievement.
assessment.attribution: Single-writer citation is straightforward. A suitable scope would be the body of experimental fiction that reinvents narrative perception in Chinese. Her essays and criticism could be mentioned, but the case rests on the fiction.
assessment.maturity: A long, productive career with an unusually consistent artistic project, so the oeuvre appears mature and durable. Timing is open because the work is demanding and reception has been uneven.
uncertainties: The prose is deeply tied to the Chinese original and the English translations are mediated, so voice and linguistic achievement are hard to judge without Chinese reading.
Corpus coverage in translation is partial, and I cannot independently verify how much of the oeuvre is available.
Some readers may find the work repetitive or hermetic, and the sustained quality across the full output needs more checking.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Hybrid works that remake the borders between classical scholarship, lyric, essay, translation, narrative and visual form (Autobiography of Red, Nox, and essays such as Eros the Bittersweet). The voice is unmistakable and the formal inventiveness is high. Her engagement with Greek antiquity and with grief gives the work intellectual and emotional depth.
assessment.attribution: Single-writer citation is clear. The scope would be a body of work that renews poetry and the essay through hybrid forms and classical reception. Her translations and stage work are part of the practice but are secondary to the core case.
assessment.maturity: Several decades of consistently inventive work with a large critical literature. The oeuvre is substantial rather than voluminous, so the question is whether the breadth is enough.
uncertainties: Her range, spanning poetry, translation, scholarship and book-object works, makes it unclear which genre the citation should centre on.
The work is written in English, so translation uncertainty is limited, but the intertextual density depends on classical knowledge.
Some of the book-object and performance work may not be fully captured by the written text.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Large, polyphonic novels (Carpentaria, The Swan Book) that remake the novel through Aboriginal sovereignty, oral storytelling forms and ecological time. The scale, linguistic energy and political-imaginative depth are exceptional. The work shows formal ambition that cannot be reduced to testimony or protest. Her nonfiction on Indigenous memory and history, and her more recent long novel, widen the case.
assessment.attribution: Single-writer citation is clear. The scope would be a body of epic fiction that extends the novel with Indigenous Australian narrative forms and ecological imagination.
assessment.maturity: The major novels span roughly two decades and are still developing. Her strongest claim rests on a small number of very large books, so the depth of the oeuvre is less extensive than for some candidates.
uncertainties: The number of major novels is limited, so sustained quality over a long span is harder to judge.
Her work draws on Indigenous Australian languages and oral traditions that I cannot assess directly.
Whether the full length and density of the books fits all readers is a question for committee discussion.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Visionary, densely patterned prose that turns memory, the body and dream into an expansive metaphysical project (Blinding, i.e. the Orbitor trilogy, and Solenoid). The voice is highly individual and the imaginative ambition is large. He is also a poet, and the lyric intensity is felt in the prose.
assessment.attribution: Single-writer citation is clear. The scope would be a body of novelistic and poetic work that builds an encyclopedic inner cosmos in Romanian.
assessment.maturity: A long career from poetry in the 1980s to monumental late novels, so the oeuvre looks substantial and developing. Recent work suggests he is still at full strength.
uncertainties: The baroque style depends on Romanian wordplay and register, so translated versions may flatten it.
Some of the long books may be repetitive in their motifs, and this needs careful judgment.
My knowledge of the poetry and the earlier prose is less detailed than of the major novels.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Dense, compressed prose that turns obscure lives and the history of art into narrative inquiry (Small Lives, The Eleven). The sentences are tightly worked, and the voice has a strongly classical and elevated register. Formal and linguistic achievement is the core of the case.
assessment.attribution: Single-writer citation is clear. The scope would be a body of short, intense books that renew the French literary tradition through biography-like fiction on art and vocation.
assessment.maturity: The oeuvre is deliberately small and sustained at a high level over decades. Brevity gives concentration but a narrower body of work.
uncertainties: The style is difficult to carry into translation, so assessment through English is limited.
The relatively small oeuvre and narrow range could weigh against the significance criterion.
I cannot verify the full bibliography beyond the main titles.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Meditative prose and moral interiority that bring theology, family and American history into conversation (Housekeeping, Gilead). The voice is calm and distinctive, and the novels combine formal restraint with real intellectual depth. Her essays add a second line of achievement.
assessment.attribution: Single-writer citation is clear. The scope would be a small body of novels and essays that renew spiritual and ethical reflection in fiction.
assessment.maturity: A long career with few novels but very high consistency. The Gilead sequence is a coherent late project.
uncertainties: The fiction output is limited in number, which bears on depth of oeuvre.
The Christian and Calvinist frame may be received differently across readerships, and the committee would have to judge its universal reach.
Her essays are less central to the literary case and their weight is uncertain.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Bilingual writing in Japanese and German that turns linguistic estrangement into inventive narrative, poetic and dramatic forms (The Emissary, Memoirs of a Polar Bear). Wordplay, metamorphosis and a distinctive voice mark the work, and the formal approach to language itself is a sustained achievement.
assessment.attribution: Single-writer citation is clear. The scope would be a body of work that explores language, translation and displacement across two literary languages and several genres.
assessment.maturity: Several decades of work in two languages, with a broad range of forms. Reception is growing, and the oeuvre appears mature.
uncertainties: Much of the linguistic play depends on the interaction of Japanese and German, so English translations capture only part of it.
I cannot assess consistency across the full body of work in both languages.
The range of genres may make it hard to define a single citation.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Large poetic sequences and landscape-scale interventions that turn suffering and the history of Chilean dictatorship into collective memorial form (Purgatory, Anteparadise). The ambition and the fusion of the personal and the historical are of high quality, and the poetry has an unusual visionary register.
assessment.attribution: Single-writer citation is clear. The scope would be a poetic oeuvre that reinvents elegy and public memory in Spanish.
assessment.maturity: More than four decades of work with a coherent project. The poetry is mature and widely acknowledged in the Spanish-speaking world.
uncertainties: Poetry depends heavily on the original language, and translated selections give only partial access.
Some of the landscape and visual interventions are not fully captured in book form.
The political-historical context could dominate the reception, and the committee should separate this from literary merit.
